asks: Which one of those do you think is you?
Do you want to see the far end?
description: The mirror isn't a mirror, it's a doorway onto a corridor identical to this room repeated away into the distance, every copy very slightly smaller, and there's no end visible in any of them.
emotes: {it} deepens by one room, and every copy shuffles along.
{it} shows something moving, a long way down, and then does not.
{it} brightens all the way to the vanishing point, briefly.
looks: The seventh copy along has something moving in it. The sixth and eighth do not.
Each room is a little smaller and a little dimmer, at a rate you could work out if you wanted.
You're in every one of them, standing exactly like this, at every size.
name: a corridor going back forever
says: There's no last one. I have checked.
The far ones are already doing what you're about to.
Wave. See how long it takes.
